entities.summary: Harold Vernon Froehlich is a retired American politician and judge. He served one term in the U.S. House of Representatives, representing Wisconsin's 8th congressional district during the 93rd Congress (1973–1975). A Republican, he broke with his party to vote for the impeachment of President Richard M. Nixon.
